answer: Hardware security-key attestation: each identity binds one physical FIDO2 key, whose copper contacts sign a fresh epoch challenge only that key can answer. One key maps to one identity, so a farm wanting a hundred votes must buy and physically tap a hundred keys every epoch, like tending a vine of a hundred separate stems. Keys cannot be cloned, and a key caught signing for two identities is burned with its stake, collapsing the nebula of puppet accounts to one vote. Honest users tap once; attackers pay a hundred devices and a hundred taps, with no bulk discount.
